topic: Body Structures of Animals for Adaptation and Survival
key_concepts: Habitat is the environmental area where a species lives
Aquatic animals live in water and terrestrial animals live on land
Fish have scales, gills, and fins for protection, breathing, and swimming
Shrimp and lobsters have exoskeletons while clams and mussels have shells
Body coverings include fur for warmth, feathers for flying, and smooth skin for breathing
Animals have body parts for movement such as legs for walking and wings for flying
Land animals have lungs for breathing
Adaptation is a structure or behavior that helps an organism survive in its environment
Animals use different mouthparts such as paws, claws, beaks, teeth, sticky tongues, and su
Teeth shape relates to diet: flat teeth for plants, sharp teeth for meat, and both for ani
Camouflage is protective coloration that helps animals blend with their surroundings
Mimicry is imitating the shapes, smells, tastes, colors, or sounds of other animals
